cost: The hunt tax was re-ratified 3.65 -> 3.67 on this branch's pool (window about 3.661 to 3.680, true midpoint by r126's rule). It is a BRANCH figure: the integrator re-sweeps once from main's constant on the merged pool and this number is superseded, not stacked.

The harness's ovr>=55 sample indexes against pool.length, and this round moves it 6,579 -> 6,582 (7 crossings, 5 in / 2 out), which redraws all 200 matchups. Three other constant triples inside the round's own feasible band were measured end to end and each broke a DIFFERENT subset of rows; at 0.16/0.78/0.84 hunt's window was EMPTY (blind -0.3007 at 3.560 against oracle +0.4934; +0.5000 at 3.545 against blind -0.2880). That is sampling, not calibration, and a later round that moves the pool should expect the same.
recal_116's two closed doors were re-measured on this pipeline and BOTH still fail, so they stay closed: the raw-leg ceiling above 0.54, and the 25 -> usg normalisation of the adjusted rate.
The subject's OFF did not move (95). A parallel OFF/DEF round 198 raises Kevin Durant '13's OFF to 98 +-1 and was told this change was coming; it now reads him at ballsec 53, not 62.
Kevin Durant '12 (ballsec 61 -> 51, OFF 93 -> 92) and '16 (63 -> 60) move with him because the fault is the same one on the same card class, and the season blend carries some of it into '13.
notes: THE GENERAL FAULT, not a fact about Durant. recal_79's allowance adds 0.8 x AST% to the responsibility denominator of the adjusted turnover rate. Its SIZE is set by the denominator, not by the passing: at USG 29.8 / AST% 21.7 — a wing's share, the 76th percentile of 2013 — it adds 17.4 to a 29.8 denominator and carries the card from the 59th percentile of 2013's RAW turnover rate to the 14th of the adjusted one. A 45-point rank gift on a card that assists 6.2 per 100 against 4.6 turnovers.

WHAT IS PRICED IS THE BENEFIT, not the allowance. The allowance itself (0.8 x AST%, the 25 normaliser) is untouched; what changed is what the resulting rank DISCOUNT costs. The first 0.16 of rank is free to everyone, because a man who passes at all does manufacture some turnovers passing, and that free band is the entire benefit for most of the board — Jordan '88 0.047, Carmelo '13 0.090, Howard '11 0.065, all three byte-identical after this round. The rest is bought with the within-season percentile of assist share: nothing below the 78th, in full at the 86th. Harden '19 0.983, Westbrook '15 0.992, Magic '90 0.99, Stockton 0.999, LeBron '13 0.96 — every hub the allowance was built for is past the top and none moves by a point.

THE RE-RANK IS LOAD-BEARING. A one-sided discount left in raw percentile space is a DEFLATION: it walks the whole board down ~1.5 points of ball security and breaks five anchors by rounding alone (Jordan '89 OFF 97, Zion '21 90, Howard '11 76, Shaq '09 69, Warriors '17 offdial 98). The adjusted leg is a within-season RANK, so the discounted readings are ranked again and the season's level is held: mean ball security moves +0.02 across 10,000 cards, OFF +0.001, and 319 of the 622 OFF moves are UP.

FOUR OTHER SHAPES MEASURED AND REJECTED. (a) Raising recal_116's raw-leg ceiling: Durant needs 0.84, which reads Harden '19 ballsec 34. (b) Normalising the adjusted rate by the card's own usage (25 -> usg; recal_116's option (b) in another dress): at half strength Durant reaches 55 but Harden falls to 49 and Mark Jackson '98 rises 10, and at full strength Jordan '88 reads 93, Luka '23 falls 17 and the top 12 becomes low-usage spot-up shooters (T.R. Dunn '87 +60). (c) Paying the allowance only on assist share above what the card's usage implies (a per-season OLS of AST% on USG%): nearly rank-neutral among non-passers — Durant reaches only 59 at full strength while Mark Jackson '98 rises 9. (d) The creation ramp applied TWO-SIDED, as a weight on the adjusted LEG rather than on its benefit: Durant lands but the low-usage tail is handed the leg's penalty back and 6,479 cards move past 3 points (T.R. Dunn '87 +53, Luke Kornet '26 +41).

THE FREE BAND IS WHAT KEEPS THE ROUND HONEST ABOUT HIS OWN SHAPE. Without it the same landing costs Howard '11 OFF 76 against recal_52's 78 +-1, and Carmelo '13 (9.3 / 14.1) and Kawhi '17 (9.1 / 18.9) — the careful low-assist scorers his ruling names approvingly at 91 and 90 — lose 4 and 3 points for nothing. Both are byte-identical as it stands.

FOOTPRINT: 4,383 ballsec bars moved, 324 by more than 3, max 15, mean +0.02. OFF 622 (range -2 to +1), OVR 357 (all +-1), DEF exactly 0. The top 12 by ball security is IDENTICAL before and after. The class that takes the charge reads like one: high-usage bigs and wings who turn it over at a hub's rate on a wing's assist share — Embiid '18-'22, Cousins '14-'18, Wembanyama '24-'25, Zach LaVine '19-'20, Paul George '16 and '21.
